dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-contrast, scalloped perimeters with a sharp transition from the dark dorsal background to light-gray internal filigree.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid light-intensity clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated in the anterior neck region and scattered along the lower lateral ventral boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most prominent dorsal annuli form an irregular quadrilateral; a secondary cluster of three smaller points on the upper flank forms an acute triangle.
